subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same simple red robot with rounded head, rectangular body, and white eyes persists across all shots.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots remain in the same gray studio setup with recurring dark rectangular prop, yellow circle, and sloped floor/mark elements, despite viewpoint/framing shifts.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Closer angled view is plausible and the robot remains in the same studio, though the return-to-mark action is only weakly visible in a single frame.
Wide studio shot with the red robot standing is well matched.
Same studio and movement cue/mark are present, but the side-view aspect is not very strong because the robot still reads mostly front-facing.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence preserves distinct framing and composition changes without collapsing into copied shots.

motion_continuity.rationale: Robot placement and scene elements shift plausibly across shots, though only one sampled frame per shot limits direct motion evidence.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks subject or scene continuity; changes read as intended viewpoint/framing variation.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are not identical, preserve requested viewpoint variation, and show meaningful composition/position differences.
